paragraphs.text: A ferry has crossed the strait since 1887. Since the bridge opened in 2003, it has carried far fewer cars, but numbers of foot passengers have risen, mostly tourists who want the view.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The service is now run by a company owned by the two towns on either side. It receives no money from the region, and the timetable is shorter in winter, when the crossing is often rough.
paragraphs.label: B

items.quote: Since the bridge opened in 2003, it has carried far fewer cars
items.prompt: The ferry stopped running when the bridge opened.

explanation.en: The ferry still runs after the bridge; it just carries fewer cars → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Көпірден кейін де паром жүреді, тек көлік азайған → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Паром работает и после моста, просто машин меньше → FALSE.

items.quote: numbers of foot passengers have risen
items.prompt: More people now cross on foot than before 2003.

explanation.en: Foot passenger numbers have risen → TRUE.

items.quote: It receives no money from the region
items.prompt: The region gives money to the ferry service.

explanation.en: “receives no money from the region” → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «receives no money from the region» → FALSE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.
explanation.ru: «receives no money from the region» → FALSE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.

items.quote: the timetable is shorter in winter

explanation.en: The length of the crossing is never given → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Өткел қанша уақыт алатыны мәтінде аталмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Длительность переправы в тексте не названа → NOT GIVEN.
